The error is in the Q5 HOW (method of evaluation). Critics treat a single Q2 WHAT (a verbal slip) as a Q1 WHO (a fundamental character flaw), ignoring the context of the event.

The Unavoidable Truth: Public figures are subject to extreme scrutiny where every pause is analyzed for deeper meaning.

The Unavoidable Lie: That a single verbal slip is a definitive diagnostic of cognitive capacity.

We must distinguish between systemic policy failure and the natural entropy of human speech. A slip is not a structural collapse of the state.
